1.text: Zaburi ya Dawidi.Uwiteka, umva gusenga kwanjye,Tegera ugutwi kwinginga kwanjye,Unsubize ku bw'umurava wawe no gukiranuka kwawe.

2.text: Kandi ntushyire umugaragu wawe mu rubanza,Kuko ari nta wo mu babaho uzatsindira mu maso yawe.

3.text: Kuko umwanzi yagenjeje umutima wanjye,Yakubise ubugingo bwanjye abutsinda hasi,Yantuje mu mwijima nk'abapfuye kera.

4.text: Ni cyo gitumye umwuka wanjye ugwira isari muri jye,Umutima wanjye ukūmirirwa muri jye.

5.text: Nibutse iminsi ya kera,Nibwira ibyo wakoze byose,Ntekereza umurimo w'intoki zawe.

6.text: Nkuramburira amaboko,Umutima wanjye ukugirira inyota,Nk'iy'igihugu kiruhijwe n'amapfa.Sela.

7.text: Uwiteka, tebuka unsubize,Umutima wanjye urashira.Ntumpishe mu maso hawe,Kugira ngo ne guhinduka nk'abamanuka bajya muri rwa rwobo.

8.text: Mu gitondo unyumvishe imbabazi zawe,Kuko ari wowe niringira.Umenyeshe inzira nkwiriye kunyuramo,Kuko ari wowe ncururira umutima.

9.text: Uwiteka, nkiza abanzi banjye,Ni wowe mpungiyeho ngo umpishe.

10.text: Unyigishe gukora ibyo ushaka,Kuko ari wowe Mana yanjye,Umwuka wawe mwiza anyobore mu gihugu cy'ikibaya.

11.text: Uwiteka, unzure ku bw'izina ryawe,Ukure umutima wanjye mu mubabaro ku bwo gukiranuka kwawe.

12.text: Kandi urimbure abanzi banjye ku bw'imbabazi zawe,Utsembe abahata umutima wanjye,Kuko ndi umugaragu wawe.
